author: Ryan Shirley
description:
I recently returned from traveling across Bosnia & Herzegovina and I want to share with you my favorite places. Enjoy this Bosnia travel guide featuring its best destinations. From the emerald waters of the Kravica Waterfall, to the historical capital of Sarajevo, Bosnia & Herzegovina has so much to offer. Where is your favorite place?

Special thanks to @dronba for helping with some shots! They make great videos of Bosnia.
